claim: PJM extended its Maximum Generation Emergency/Load Management Alert (NERC EEA 1) through the October 14, 2026 operating day and separately identified a reliability need to utilize the Exhibit A resources covered by DOE Order 202-26-50 on October 14. The notice does not itself direct full-load operation; individual resources remain subject to PJM commitment and dispatch instructions.
falsifier: A corrected or withdrawn PJM primary posting showing that EEA 1 does not apply on October 14, or that PJM did not identify a reliability need for the Exhibit A resources on that operating day, would contradict this finding. Actual dispatch and output remain separately untested.
firstUnsupportedArrow: Identified reliability need and EEA 1 posture -> resource-specific commitment or dispatch -> resource availability and execution -> delivered megawatts -> avoided reliability consequence.
omissions: No resource-specific October 14 commitment or dispatch record is included.
No required, scheduled or delivered megawatts are stated.
The notice does not establish maximum-output or full-load operation.
No Emergency Use of Back-Up Generator Warning or Action is shown in the retrieved posting.
Backup-generator independent reachability, fuel, emissions, start success and delivered power remain unknown.
Ultimate operating, environmental and rate-recovery cost allocation remains unknown.
No release, cancellation or de-escalation record for the October 13 demand-response actions is included.
failures: Public postings do not expose unit-level dispatch instructions or execution telemetry.
No DOE daily resource report or verified delivered-capacity record was retrieved.
rivalHypotheses: The October 14 notices reflect genuine anticipated scarcity requiring additional out-of-market resource use.
The notices are precautionary continuity measures issued because tight capacity remains plausible, without proving that the resources will be committed or needed.
Resource availability, forecast changes or imports may remove the operational need before individual dispatch occurs.

priorFindingReference.relationship: Earlier October 13 mandatory Quick_30 demand-response dispatch candidate; not evidence of October 14 resource execution.

notes: This candidate records announced operating posture and identified need, not completed dispatch, backup-generator use, restored capacity or avoided outage.
